{{Quote|Four years ago he was crossed by a family from Volke House on Shikaakwa. They’d bought some information from him that helped them establish a production base in Crystal City, a dome eight hundred kilometers south of here.|[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tre Sana]] to [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] about Volke House of [[Shikaakwa]]|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
'''Volke House''' was one of the [[Nine Houses]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

==History==
In [[25,797 BBY]], a family from Volke House contacted [[Maxhagan]], a local [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]], for information about a potential Nox settlement. The latter then provided them with crucial information to create a production base in [[Crystal City (Nox)|Crystal City]], one of the many manufacturing domes on the planet. However, after setting up their business in Crystal City, Volke House refused to pay Maxhagan and killed three of his emissaries.<ref name="Into the Void" />

The latter, in revenge, then initiated a [[feud in Crystal City]] against the installation of Volke House which resulted in a skirmish that caused the death of three thousand people, thus wiping out the Volke family's entire network on Nox.<ref name="Into the Void" />
